label: D2 after choosing a2 again following an unrewarded (rare) trial, late in the episode (trial >= 75)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when this trial chose a2 (in_action=2), only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99% of mass), and only in the last part of the episode (zero before trial 50, rising steeply through trials 70-99). The previous trial was almost always a rare transition (prev_common=0 holds 83% of mass; prev_common=1 only 0.4%; the rest is the window first trial where prev_common is unknown), typically a2 -> S1 rare, no reward, then a2 repeated. Magnitude is highest when the current D2 shows S2 (common; ~90% of mass, activations near max) and about half as large when the current a2 lands rare in S1. Coincides with low value and a strongly a2-favoring policy. Never fires at D1/GO, after a1 choices, or after a rewarded trial. All variables are observed at D2 (ep_trial is elapsed time). Precision is limited (~0.74 dev) mostly by window-first trials where prev_common is unknown and by the soft ep_trial cutoff; requiring prev_common==0 raises precision to 0.86 but drops mass recall to 0.79.
